title: No Onion No Garlic 😳 Delhi Ka Sabse Unique Satvik Food Stall | Model Town #chillitadka  #streetfood
description:
Aaj Chilli Tadka pahunch gaya Model Town, Delhi jahan hum mile ek dil jeet lene wale street food hero se ❤️

Ye hai Maa Vaishno Rasoi — jo pichle 5+ saalon se apni WagonR car se Pure Satvik Food (No Onion No Garlic) serve kar rahe hain 🙏

Delhi mein jahan fast food ka craze badh raha hai, wahan itna pure aur home-style Vaishno bhog milna sach mein rare hai.

Is video mein aap dekhenge:
🍛 Pure Satvik thali
🚗 WagonR se chalti rasoi
🙏 5 saal ki lagan aur seva
💰 Affordable aur pet bhar khana

Agar aap No Onion No Garlic food pasand karte hain ya Delhi mein Satvik khana dhund rahe hain — ye video aapke liye hai!

📍 Location: Model Town, Delhi
🍛 Specialty: Pure Satvik Meals (No Onion | No Garlic)
🎥 By: Chilli Tadka
